ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: there are two small maps in the figure, labeled A and B respectively, and with a legend. The legend shows that the linear symbols include rivers and railways, and dots indicate cities. Near Map A are marked about 29°30′ and 106°30′; multiple rivers and railways converge near a city, and the location corresponds to the Chongqing area. Near Map B are marked about 30°40′ and 104°; there are also river, railway, and city symbols, and the location corresponds to the Chengdu area. Therefore this figure represents the core cities of the Chengdu-Chongqing Economic Zone near Chengdu and Chongqing. Then reason: the question stem asks about the "greatest obstacle" to the planned construction of 12 intercity passenger dedicated lines in the Chengdu-Chongqing Economic Zone. Intercity passenger dedicated lines have high requirements for line smoothness, bridge and tunnel engineering, and subgrade stability; the Chengdu-Chongqing region is located in the Sichuan Basin and its periphery, where mountains and hills are widely distributed, and fault structures and complex strata are relatively developed, so railway construction is more easily constrained by topographic and geological engineering conditions. Therefore the greatest obstacle should be complex geological conditions.
